one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-11-24 to 2026-12-23. No Intel earnings (Q4 report late January). In the window: HP and Dell results on 2026-11-24 after the close (src 24), the main PC-demand read-through for the memory-constrained 2027 PC TAM; mid-December FOMC; continued AI/semis sentiment swings (the stock fell ~14% in the week to 11-20 and then rose 16.3% on 11-23 with the chip rebound on the reported Nvidia CEO change, with no Intel-specific news, src 25). No dated event with a directional edge, so a near-symmetric lognormal: median 59.3 (a slight give-back after a one-day +16% sector move, short-horizon reversal) and a 22% monthly sigma (between the 86% annual realised vol / 3.5 = 24.6% and a calmer post-rebound tape). HP/Dell PC commentary is the main two-way risk.

fair_value.method: Research target (12m) $58.92: 80% P/E leg (build NTM GAAP after-SBC EPS after the NCI share ~$1.644 at the horizon x 40.1x, the k=0.8 shrink of INTC's own 46.5x toward the 22.1x peer median at 11-23 closes) = $65.92; 20% mid-cycle leg (mid-cycle EPS $1.40 from Intel's 2016-2025 average 14.7% operating margin x 22.1x through-cycle peer P/E) = $30.9. Shares 5,506M flat, SBC expensed once.

downside.story: P10 (~$27.18): PC units fall ~19% in 2027 instead of 10% as the memory crunch and OEM inventory flush run into 2H27 (TrendForce PC DRAM contract prices still +13-18% QoQ in 4Q26, src 9; IDC Q3 units -20.1%, src 10); server CPU units 8% below the CFO's >30% path on AI-capex digestion after the November sell-off (src 17, src 25) while Arm reaches ~30% of server CPUs and AMD keeps rising (TrendForce, src 22; Mercury, src 11), cutting Intel's DCAI capture 6%; margins 200bp lower on under-absorption; P/E derates to ~29x as no external 14A anchor is named and the foundry option fades.

base.story: Median $58.92: PC units -12% in 2026 and -10% in 2027 (CFO plan, src 21), partial recovery in 2028; server CPU units +30%/+30%/+10% with Intel supply-limited and losing share to Arm and AMD (src 22, src 11), DCAI ~$37.5B / ~$41.0B; revenue ~$61.6B / $68.1B / $75.3B; GAAP EBIT after SBC and the NCI share; EPS $1.19 FY2027, $1.69 FY2028 on 5,506M shares; 40.1x NTM at the horizon (80%) and a 20% mid-cycle check.

upside.story: P90 (~$103.55): DRAM relief in 2H27 (src 9) keeps 2027 PC units near -3%; server units run above +30% and Intel's added substrate/wafer supply lands in 2H27 (CFO, src 21), lifting DCAI capture 5%; margins +200bp on absorption; a named 14A anchor and 18A/18A-P customer revenue (CEO 'first customer' for 18A, src 27; src 15, src 18) re-rate the stock to ~52x NTM EPS.

reasoning: Round 2 rebuild after the supervisor's feedback. Kept: the alt-data driver build (IDC Q3 PC units -20.1%, src 10; TrendForce PC DRAM +13-18% QoQ in 4Q26, src 9; Mercury Q3 shares, src 11; Steam survey, src 12; Polymarket had no Intel market, src 13) mapped through PC unit TAM x CCPG capture and server CPU unit TAM x DCAI capture, with FY2028 DCAI ~$41.0B (the build the supervisor carded as the recommended option, now also backed by TrendForce 2026-10-22: Arm ~30% of server CPUs in 2027, AMD rising, Intel's next-gen in limited supply, src 22). Fixed: (1) shares 5,307M +1.5%/yr -> 5,506M flat (CFO Q4 5.44B, src 21, plus half of the 132M escrowed DoC shares, src 26), so SBC is counted once as a cost; (2) NCI: the $16B equity deduction is replaced by the CFO's ~$1.1B a year NCI share (src 21) inside EBIT as a pre-tax cost (1,250), so the P/E leg runs on attributable EPS like the 46.5x own multiple, counted once; (3) peer median re-struck at 11-23 closes (22.1x, src 26; round 1's 22.4x was on 10-30 prices) and exit 40.1x; (4) the normalised leg is now genuinely independent: mid-cycle EPS from Intel's 2016-2025 average 14.7% operating margin (src 23) x a 22.1x through-cycle peer P/E, weight 0.2; (5) Substack figures (TradingToni, Beyond The Hype) are colour only, no number rests on them; the Q4 DCAI estimate is now guide arithmetic (15.5B mid - CCPG ~6.2B - Other ~0.7B ~ 8.6B, src 1, src 21). Result: P/E leg $65.92 (x0.8) and mid-cycle $30.9 (x0.2) = $58.92, ~flat to the $59.66 close and below the S&P Global mean analyst target $90.65 (src 24, evidence not the answer); the gap to the street is the NCI drag, the share count and my supply-limited DCAI path. Scenarios: P10 $27.18 / P90 $103.55 (drivers + margin + multiple, a fatter left tail consistent with the 86% realised vol). Alt signals: CEO's family trust bought 150k shares at $64.73 on 11-02 (src 24), mildly positive; the 11-23 +16% was a sector move with no Intel news (src 25).

drivers.label: CCPG revenue per PC TAM index point ($M): Intel unit share x client ASP
drivers.derivation: Base 32,200/100. FY2026 CCPG = Q1 ~7,700 (est: Q1 total 13,577 = H1 29,705 (F6/F7 arithmetic) - Q2 16,128 (src 4), split by Q2-Q3 mix) + Q2 8,877 (src 4) + Q3 8,097 (src 1) + Q4 ~6,200 (CFO: >20% sequential decline, src 5) = 30,870 -> /88 = 350.8 (price hikes and mix; Mercury shows Intel desktop share back to 70.1%, src 11). FY2027 334.6: sell-in below sell-through in 1H27 while OEMs cut weeks of inventory (src 5; Beyond The Hype src 8 as colour) = ~5% drag on capture -> CCPG 26,500. FY2028 342.7: inventory normal, capture between 2026 and 2027 as AMD keeps gaining notebook share (risk) -> CCPG 29,300.
drivers.why: Share x ASP; separates Intel's position from the market.

drivers.label: Industry server CPU unit index (FY2025 = 100)
drivers.derivation: CFO: industry server CPU units >+30% in both 2026 and 2027 (src 5) -> 130, 169 (taken at +30%, the floor of '>30%', because the industry is supply-constrained through 2027 per the same call). 2028 +10% (supply-constrained 'into 2028', src 5, then digestion); JPR 8.13M server CPUs in Q3 2026 (src 11) is consistent with a ~30M+/yr run-rate.
drivers.why: Agentic/AI CPU demand is the economic driver of DCAI.

drivers.label: DCAI revenue per server index point ($M): Intel share x ASP incl. purpose-built silicon
drivers.derivation: Base 16,900/100. FY2026 DCAI = Q1 ~5,000 (est, as above) + Q2 6,262 (src 4) + Q3 7,318 (src 1) + Q4 ~8,500 (guide arithmetic: 15.5B mid - CCPG ~6.2B - Other ~0.7B = ~8.6B, src 1/src 21) = 27,080 -> /130 = 208.3. FY2027 37,500 /169 = 221.9: management called annualised Q4 (~$34B) 'a good starting point' with growth back-end loaded (management on the Q3 call, src 5), +10% over that; capture rises only ~6.5% because AMD keeps taking ~1pt of server share a quarter (35.5% in Q3, src 11) while ASPs/ASIC mix rise. FY2028 41,000 /185.9 = 220.5: flat capture as share loss offsets pricing.
drivers.why: Share x ASP for server CPUs and custom ASICs.

model_inputs.structure_note: Value carried by a P/E horizon leg (0.8) on the build's own GAAP after-SBC, after-NCI NTM EPS at 2027-11-23 (mostly FY2028) at 40.1x (k-rule), plus a mid-cycle EPS x through-cycle P/E cross-check (0.2, not driver-linked). Driver build: PC unit TAM x CCPG capture; server CPU unit TAM x DCAI capture; Other residual; segment margins and a corporate line (foundry loss + unallocated + eliminations + NCI share pre-tax). No DCF (policy). No FCF-yield leg: FCFF is negative in FY2026-27 (CFO: capex up strongly in 2027), so the >=2% FCF margin test fails. Annual set (a quarterly rebuild needs Kilian's driver approval card).
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) mid-cycle leg weight 0.2 at a 22.1x through-cycle P/E: at weight 0 the target would be the P/E leg alone ($65.92, +12%) - card; it carries no foundry option by design. (2) exit k = 0.8: k = 0.7 gives 37.2x (about -6%). (3) NCI at ~$1.1B a year inside EPS (CFO) vs book 16,642 (src 26): book would add ~$5/share (~+8%) - card. (4) Escrowed DoC shares: 66 of 132M counted (0 to 132M moves value under 2%). (5) Equity raise in 12 months ~10% (net cash $3.9B, ~$54B cash and investments, FY2027 FCFF slightly negative), below the 20% bar; DoC warrants (241M) ~10%, not booked. (6) Q1 2026 segment split (CCPG ~7.7B, DCAI ~5.0B) is an estimate.
